repos.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供专为真实工程场景设计的轻量级AI代理技能（Skills），源自作者日常使用的.claude目录。这些技能强调可组合性、易适配性，并解决AI编码中的典型问题，如需求对齐偏差与沟通冗余。通过/grill-me等工具引导深度提问，提升AI理解准确性，适用于各类大模型，助力开发者实现高效可控的工程实践。
repos.summary_en: This repo offers lightweight, composable AI agent skills for real engineering, sourced from the author's .claude directory. Designed to fix common AI coding pitfalls like misalignment and verbosity, skills such as /grill-me prompt detailed questioning to improve clarity. Compatible with any model, they empower developers with control and precision in software development.

repos.description: Public repository for Agent Skills
repos.summary_zh: Anthropic 公开 Claude 智能体技能库，提供文档处理、开发工具、企业工作流等多样化技能模板，支持动态加载与自定义扩展，助力 AI 智能体实现专业化任务自动化。
repos.summary_en: Anthropic's public repository for Agent Skills provides Claude with dynamic, modular capabilities across document processing, development tools, and enterprise workflows, enabling specialized task automation through customizable, production-grade skill modules.

repos.description: FULL Augment Code, Claude Code, Cluely, CodeBuddy, Comet, Cursor, Devin AI, Junie, Kiro, Leap.new, Lovable, Manus, NotionAI, Orchids.app, Perplexity, Poke, Qoder, Replit, Same.dev, Trae, Traycer AI, VSCode Agent, Warp.dev, Windsurf, Xcode, Z.ai Code, Dia & v0. (And other Open Sourced) System Prompts, Internal Tools & AI Models
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库汇集了30,000+行关于主流AI编程工具（如Claude Code、Cursor、Devin AI等）的系统提示、内部工具和模型架构的深度解析，涵盖其设计理念、功能实现与技术细节，为开发者提供全面的AI编程助手技术洞察与最佳实践参考。
repos.summary_en: This repository contains over 30,000 lines of insights into system prompts, internal tools, and AI models of major AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Devin AI), offering deep technical analysis of their architecture, functionality, and design principles for developers seeking to understand and leverage AI-powered development tools.

repos.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
repos.summary_zh: Agent Skills 是一套为 AI 编码代理设计的生产级工程技能体系，涵盖从需求定义到部署上线的完整开发生命周期。通过 7 个核心命令（如 /spec、/build、/test）和 19 个专项技能，强制实施规格先行、增量构建、测试驱动等资深工程师的最佳实践，确保代码质量与可维护性。
repos.summary_en: Agent Skills provides production-grade engineering workflows for AI coding agents, covering the entire software development lifecycle from idea to deployment. With 7 core commands (e.g., /spec, /build, /test) and 19 specialized skills, it enforces senior engineer best practices like spec-first development, incremental builds, and test-driven verification.

repos.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent –  Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
repos.summary_zh: Claude-Mem 是专为 Claude Code 设计的持久化记忆压缩系统，通过 AI 自动捕获、压缩编码开发会话中的关键信息，并在后续会话中智能注入相关上下文，显著提升 AI 编程助手的工作记忆效率与连续性。
repos.summary_en: Claude-Mem is a persistent memory compression system for Claude Code that automatically captures, compresses, and injects relevant context from coding sessions using AI, enhancing Claude's working memory and session continuity.

repos.description: Turn any idea, plan, or codebase into a beautiful interactive diagram. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, and more.
repos.summary_zh: Archify是一款AI代理技能，可将自然语言描述即时转化为可交互的自包含HTML可视化图表，支持架构图、工作流、序列图、数据流等类型，内置动画效果与简洁导出，无缝集成Cursor、Claude Code等主流AI编程工具。
repos.summary_en: Archify is an AI agent skill that instantly converts natural language descriptions into interactive self-contained HTML visualizations, supporting architecture diagrams, workflows, sequence diagrams, and data flows with built-in animations and clean export. It integrates seamlessly with Cursor, Claude Code, and other major AI coding tools.

repos.description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
repos.summary_zh: Impeccable 是一个专为 AI 前端设计优化的提示工程框架，基于 Anthropic 的 frontend-design 技能扩展而来。它提供 17 个精准指令和 7 个领域专项参考文件，涵盖排版、色彩、动效等设计维度，并内置反模式指南，有效规避模板化设计。支持 Cursor 等 AI 工具，显著提升生成 UI 的专业性与一致性。
repos.summary_en: Impeccable is a prompt engineering framework that enhances AI-driven frontend design by building on Anthropic's frontend-design skill. It offers 17 precise steering commands and 7 domain-specific reference files covering typography, color, motion, and UX writing, plus curated anti-patterns to avoid generic designs. Integrated with AI coding tools like Cursor, it ensures professional, consistent UI output.

repos.description: A curated list of awesome Claude Skills, resources, and tools for customizing Claude AI workflows
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Claude Skills 是一个精心策划的 Claude AI 技能库，涵盖文档处理、开发工具、数据分析、商业营销等十大领域。通过 Composio 插件，Claude 可连接500+应用执行真实操作（如发邮件、创建工单），实现从文本生成到自动化工作的跨越。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Claude Skills is a curated collection of practical workflows for enhancing Claude AI across platforms. It covers document processing, development tools, data analysis, business automation, and more. With the Composio plugin, Claude can connect to 500+ apps to perform real-world actions like sending emails or creating issues, extending beyond text generation.

repos.description: OmO: Just type "mass ulw" keyword with your prompt. Now you are the master of graph engineering.
repos.summary_zh: Oh My OpenAgent 是一个开源智能体开发框架，支持多模型协同工作流编排。它通过集成 Claude、GPT、Kimi、GLM、Gemini 和 Minimax 等主流大模型，实现代码生成、任务自动化与智能决策的开放生态。项目强调去中心化架构，反对厂商锁定，提供实时构建直播与 Discord 社区协作机制。
repos.summary_en: Oh My OpenAgent is an open-source agent framework enabling multi-model orchestration for code generation and automation. It integrates leading LLMs like Claude, GPT, Kimi, GLM, Gemini, and Minimax to build a decentralized ecosystem that rejects vendor lock-in. Features include real-time public development via Discord and support for diverse AI providers.

repos.description: ChatGPT 中文调教指南。各种场景使用指南。学习怎么让它听你的话。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供全面的 ChatGPT 中文调教指南，涵盖学术论文、创意写作、商业文案、翻译、数据分析等 20+ 应用场景，帮助用户掌握提示词技巧，让 AI 高效完成各类任务，提升工作效率与内容质量。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive guide to prompting ChatGPT in Chinese, covering over 20 use cases including academic writing, creative content, business communication, translation, and data analysis. It empowers users to master prompt engineering and leverage AI for enhanced productivity and content quality.

repos.description: ☄🌌️  The minimal, blazing-fast, and infinitely customizable prompt for any shell!
repos.summary_zh: Starship 是一款极简、极速且高度可定制的跨平台命令行提示符工具，支持任意 Shell（如 Bash、Zsh、Fish、PowerShell 等）。它通过 Rust 编写，性能卓越，能智能显示 Git 状态、编程语言版本、环境变量等上下文信息，极大提升终端使用效率与视觉体验。
repos.summary_en: Starship is a minimal, blazing-fast, and infinitely customizable cross-shell prompt written in Rust. It intelligently displays contextual information like Git status, language versions, and environment variables across any shell (Bash, Zsh, Fish, PowerShell, etc.), enhancing terminal productivity and aesthetics.

repos.description: Marketing skills for Claude Code and AI agents. CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.
repos.summary_zh: 专为AI代理设计的营销技能集，涵盖CRO、文案撰写、SEO、数据分析和增长工程。基于Agent Skills规范构建，支持Claude Code等主流编码代理，为技术型营销人员和创始人提供自动化营销解决方案，通过标准化技能文件实现跨平台协作与知识复用。
repos.summary_en: A collection of AI agent skills for marketing tasks including CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering. Built on the Agent Skills spec for use with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and other agents. Provides standardized workflows for technical marketers and founders to automate conversion optimization, content creation, and growth strategies.

repos.description: Agent skills for Obsidian. Teach your agent to use Obsidian CLI and open formats including Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供专为 Obsidian 设计的 Agent 技能集，支持 Markdown、Bases、JSON Canvas 和 CLI 操作，兼容 Claude Code、Codex 等 Agent 框架，实现知识管理与自动化处理的无缝集成。
repos.summary_en: This repo delivers agent skills for Obsidian, enabling creation and editing of Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas files, and CLI interactions. Fully compatible with Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode via the Agent Skills specification.

repos.description: Powerful AI Client
repos.summary_zh: Chatbox 是一款跨平台桌面 AI 客户端，支持 ChatGPT、Claude 等主流大模型，提供多端同步、插件扩展、提示工程优化等功能，适用于开发者、研究人员和AI爱好者的高效生产力工具。
repos.summary_en: Chatbox is a powerful cross-platform desktop AI client supporting ChatGPT, Claude, and other LLMs. It offers multi-device sync, plugin support, prompt engineering, and advanced customization for developers and AI enthusiasts.

repos.description: An AI prompt optimizer for writing better prompts and getting better AI results.
repos.summary_zh: Prompt Optimizer 是一款专注于提升 AI 提示词质量的优化工具，支持多轮迭代优化、双模式提示词处理、实时对比测试及多模型集成（OpenAI/Gemini/DeepSeek等），同时提供文生图、图生图、MCP协议支持等高级功能，适用于角色扮演、知识图谱提取、创意写作等场景。
repos.summary_en: Prompt Optimizer is an AI prompt optimization tool designed to enhance prompt quality through intelligent refinement, multi-round iteration, and dual-mode optimization. It supports real-time comparison, integration with major AI models (OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek), advanced features like text-to-image generation, MCP protocol compatibility, and secure client-side processing for reliable and efficient prompt engineering.

repos.description: A reliable coding agent for complex software engineering tasks.
repos.summary_zh: Reasonix 是一款专为终端设计的 DeepSeek 原生 AI 编程智能体，基于前缀缓存稳定性优化，支持长时间运行且保持低 token 成本。其核心优势在于高达 99.82% 的缓存命中率，显著降低推理开销，适用于持续编码任务。
repos.summary_en: Reasonix is a DeepSeek-native AI coding agent for the terminal, engineered for prefix-cache stability to minimize token costs during long sessions. It achieves up to 99.82% cache hit rate, drastically reducing inference expenses while enabling persistent, efficient development workflows.

repos.description: 你想蒸馏的下一个员工，何必是同事。蒸馏任何人的思维方式——心智模型、决策启发式、表达DNA。Distill how anyone thinks.
repos.summary_zh: 女娲.skill 是一个 AI 智能体技能库，通过蒸馏顶尖人物的思维方式（如乔布斯、马斯克、芒格等），将其心智模型、决策启发式和表达DNA转化为可调用技能。用户可在 Claude Code 中直接调用这些技能进行跨领域决策分析，实现‘让名人帮你打工’的愿景。
repos.summary_en: Nuwa.skill is an AI agent skill library that distills the thinking patterns of top-tier individuals (e.g., Jobs, Musk, Munger) into actionable skills. It extracts cognitive frameworks, decision heuristics, and communication DNA to enable users to invoke these 'virtual experts' via Claude Code for cross-domain strategic analysis and problem-solving.

repos.description: leaked prompts of GPTs
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库收集了多个泄露的 GPTs 提示词（prompts），涵盖开发、翻译、娱乐、教育、图像生成、视频脚本、游戏等多个领域，展示了 OpenAI GPTs 功能的广泛应用场景与技术实现方式。
repos.summary_en: This repository compiles leaked prompts from various GPTs, covering development, translation, entertainment, education, image generation, video scripting, gaming, and more, showcasing diverse use cases and technical implementations of OpenAI's GPTs platform.

repos.description: Create beautiful slides on the web using a coding agent's frontend skills
repos.summary_zh: Frontend Slides 是一个 Claude Code 技能，专为非设计师打造。它能将 PowerPoint 文件转换为精美的 HTML 幻灯片，或从零开始创建动画丰富的网页演示文稿。该工具通过视觉预览帮助用户选择设计风格，支持零依赖的单文件输出，并提供 12 种 curated 设计风格（如 Dark Botanical、Neon Cyber），避免通用 AI 审美，产出可直接用于生产的响应式、可访问性良好的代码。
repos.summary_en: Frontend Slides is a Claude Code skill that enables non-designers to create stunning, animation-rich HTML presentations from scratch or by converting PowerPoint files. It uses visual previews for style selection, supports zero-dependency single-file output, and offers 12 curated design styles (e.g., Dark Botanical, Neon Cyber) to avoid generic AI aesthetics while delivering production-ready, accessible, and responsive code.

repos.description: AI-agent Skill for generating polished HTML slide decks: editorial magazine and Swiss layouts, image prompts, social covers, and a WebGL/low-power presentation runtime.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是一个 Claude Code Skill，用于将提示词转换为横向翻页的电子杂志风格单文件 HTML PPT。支持 10 种布局、5 套主题色、WebGL 背景，适用于线下分享、AI 产品发布等场景，强调克制美学与结构优先的设计原则。
repos.summary_en: This is a Claude Code Skill that converts prompts into single-file, magazine-style HTML presentations with horizontal swiping. It offers 10 layouts, 5 curated themes, WebGL hero backgrounds, and is ideal for offline talks, AI product launches, emphasizing restrained aesthetics and structural clarity.

repos.summary_zh: 宝玉技能集为Claude Code用户提供高效日常办公工具，包含小红书图文生成、AI内容创作及实用工具三大类。支持风格化模板（可爱/清新/极简等）、色彩方案定制及批量处理，提升内容生产效率。
repos.summary_en: Baoyu Skills enhances daily work efficiency in Claude Code with content generation tools, AI utilities, and publishing helpers. Features style templates (cute/fresh/minimal), color palettes, and batch processing for streamlined content creation.

repos.description: A gallery that showcases on-device ML/GenAI use cases and allows people to try and use models locally.
repos.summary_zh: Google AI Edge Gallery 是一个展示端侧机器学习与生成式 AI 应用的实验性应用，支持在 Android 和 iOS 设备上本地运行大模型，提供离线聊天、图像问答、音频转录、提示工程等功能，并集成 Tiny Garden 小游戏与设备控制能力，实现完全离线的智能体验。
repos.summary_en: Google AI Edge Gallery is an experimental app showcasing on-device ML/GenAI use cases, enabling users to run generative AI models locally on Android and iOS. It supports offline chat, image Q&A, audio transcription, prompt engineering, and includes a mini game and device control via fine-tuned models, all without requiring an internet connection.

repos.description: 面向开发者的 LLM 入门教程，吴恩达大模型系列课程中文版
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是面向开发者的 LLM 入门教程，基于吴恩达大模型系列课程打造，覆盖 Prompt Engineering、RAG、模型微调等全流程。内容涵盖从基础 API 调用到 LangChain 应用开发，提供中文复现代码与 Prompt 优化方案，支持 Jupyter Notebook 实践，助力开发者快速掌握 LLM 应用开发技能。
repos.summary_en: This project is a developer-focused LLM入门教程 based on Andrew Ng's large language model courses, covering Prompt Engineering, RAG, and fine-tuning. It includes translated, reproduced code examples and optimized Chinese prompts, enabling hands-on learning via Jupyter Notebooks to help developers master LLM application development.

repos.summary_zh: Vibe Coding 指南是一个通过 AI 结对编程实现创意快速落地的开源项目，提供多语言支持与完整工具链，涵盖提示工程、开发流程优化及自动化部署，助力开发者高效构建原型与产品。
repos.summary_en: The Vibe Coding Guide is an open-source project enabling rapid idea-to-prototype development through AI pair programming, featuring multilingual support, prompt engineering frameworks, and automated workflows for efficient software creation.

repos.description: 数字生命卡兹克开源的 AI Skills 合集 | Agent Skills: leader（帮你定义目标）, neat-freak 洁癖, hv-analysis, khazix-writer & more — Claude Code, Codex & 40+ agents
repos.summary_zh: Khazix Skills 是一个开源的 AI 技能合集，包含多个可直接集成到 Claude Code、Codex 等智能体平台的结构化指令（Skills）和通用提示词（Prompts）。核心功能包括自动同步项目文档与记忆（neat-freak）、深度行业分析生成万字 PDF 报告（hv-analysis）以及个性化写作风格迁移（khazix-writer），旨在提升 AI 协作效率与输出一致性。
repos.summary_en: Khazix Skills is an open-source collection of AI skills and prompts designed for integration with agent platforms like Claude Code and Codex. It includes tools for auto-syncing project docs and agent memory (neat-freak), generating in-depth analytical reports via horizontal-vertical analysis (hv-analysis), and mimicking a personal writing style (khazix-writer), enhancing AI consistency and productivity.

repos.description: 🚀✨ Minimalistic, powerful and extremely customizable Zsh prompt
repos.summary_zh: Spaceship Prompt 是一款极简、强大且高度可定制的 Zsh 终端提示符，提供丰富的信息展示，包括 Git 状态、多语言运行时环境、包版本、电池电量、Kubernetes 上下文等，支持深度自定义配置，显著提升终端使用体验。
repos.summary_en: Spaceship Prompt is a minimalistic, powerful, and highly customizable Zsh prompt that displays essential information like Git status, runtime environments (Node.js, Python, etc.), package versions, battery level, and Kubernetes context, with extensive customization options for enhanced terminal productivity.

repos.description: SkillOpt is a text-space optimizer that trains reusable natural-language skills for frozen LLM agents through trajectory-driven edits, validation-gated updates, and deployable best_skill.md artifacts.
repos.summary_zh: SkillOpt 是微软开源的文本空间优化器，专为冻结的 LLM 智能体设计。它借鉴深度学习中的 epoch、batch size 和学习率等概念，通过轨迹驱动编辑和验证门控机制，自动训练可复用的自然语言技能文档（best_skill.md），无需修改模型权重即可显著提升智能体在多种基准测试中的表现。
repos.summary_en: SkillOpt is an open-source text-space optimizer by Microsoft for frozen LLM agents. Borrowing concepts like epochs and learning rates from deep learning, it automatically trains reusable natural-language skill documents (best_skill.md) through trajectory-driven edits and validation gates, significantly boosting agent performance without altering model weights.

repos.description: The fastest browser for AI agents to run browser automation, built for sharing your logged-in browser state with your AI agents, like Codex or Claude Code, without disturbing you. Zero cost, zero config.
repos.summary_zh: ego-lite 是专为 AI 智能体设计的高速浏览器，支持用户与 AI 代理并行工作。AI 可在独立空间运行浏览器任务，同时共享用户的登录状态、Cookie 和扩展，零配置零成本，无缝集成 Claude Code、Codex 等主流 AI 助手。
repos.summary_en: ego-lite is a high-performance browser built for AI agents, enabling parallel work between users and AI assistants. Agents run browser tasks in isolated spaces while sharing your logins, cookies, and extensions with zero setup cost, seamlessly integrating with Claude Code, Codex, and other leading AI tools.

repos.description: Personal memory across agents
repos.summary_zh: memU 是一个专为 24/7 主动式 AI 代理设计的内存框架，将内存建模为文件系统，支持层级分类、跨引用和持久化存储。它通过结构化记忆减少 LLM 令牌成本，实现持续理解用户意图并主动执行任务，适用于 openclaw、moltbot 等长期运行代理。
repos.summary_en: memU is a memory framework for 24/7 proactive AI agents, modeling memory as a file system with hierarchical categories, cross-references, and persistent storage. It reduces LLM token costs by caching insights and enables continuous understanding of user intent, making always-on agents practical for production systems like openclaw and moltbot.

repos.description: LangGPT: Empowering everyone to become a prompt expert! 🚀  📌 结构化提示词（Structured Prompt）提出者 📌 元提示词（Meta-Prompt）发起者   📌 最流行的提示词落地范式 | Language of GPT  The pioneering framework for structured & meta-prompt design 10,000+ ⭐ | Battle-tested by thousands of users worldwide  Created by 云中江树
repos.summary_zh: LangGPT 是一个革命性的结构化提示词设计框架，将提示词工程转化为可复用、模块化的‘提示词编程语言’。通过角色定义、目标规范、技能拆解和流程控制，帮助用户快速创建高质量 AI 提示词，已在全球超万名用户中验证有效，相关论文发表于 arXiv。
repos.summary_en: LangGPT is a pioneering framework that treats prompt design as a structured, reusable programming language. It enables anyone to create high-quality prompts through role-based templates, modular skills, and systematic workflows, backed by academic research and battle-tested by 10,000+ users worldwide.

repos.description: 👩‍🚒 Good content deserves good paper.
repos.summary_zh: Kami 是一个面向 AI 智能体的文档设计系统，通过一套约束语言和九种模板，将 AI 生成的内容自动排版为可直接交付的 PDF 与落地页。支持中英日韩多语言，提供 Claude Code 插件、通用 Agent 技能包等多种集成方式，解决 AI 输出样式不一致的问题。
repos.summary_en: Kami is a document design system for AI agents: one constraint language, nine templates, producing shippable PDFs and landing pages. Supports English, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean. Integrates via Claude Code plugin, generic agent skills, or Claude Desktop—ensuring consistent, production-ready output.

repos.description: An AI-agent skill that generates browser-editable presentations from multiple visual themes, exportable to HTML, PDF, and PPTX.
repos.summary_zh: Dashi PPT Skill 是一款 AI Agent 技能，将文档输入后自动生成带有内置编辑控制台的演示文稿。支持 12 套视觉主题、1020 个版式和丰富图表分析模型，可直接在浏览器中修改内容，并一键导出为可编辑的 HTML、PDF 和 PPTX 文件。
repos.summary_en: Dashi PPT Skill is an AI Agent skill that generates browser-editable presentations from documents, featuring 12 visual themes, 1,020 layouts, and rich chart/model templates. Users can edit slides directly in the browser and export to editable HTML, PDF, and PPTX formats with one click.

repos.description: ✨ The agentic HTML editor — your local AI agent writes the HTML, you ship it. 🚀 75 Skills × 9 Surfaces (magazine · deck · poster · XHS / tweet · prototype · data report · Hyperframes) 🛡️ Sandboxed preview · 📤 1-click to WeChat / X / Zhihu / HTML / PNG 🔑 Zero API key — Claude Code / Cursor / Codex / Gemini / Copilot / OpenCode / Qwen / Aider.
repos.summary_zh: HTML Anything 是一款本地优先的智能 HTML 编辑器，集成 8 种主流编码代理 CLI（如 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等），无需 API 密钥。提供 75 个可组合技能模板，支持 9 种输出场景（杂志、海报、数据报告、小红书卡片等），一键导出至微信、X、知乎或生成 HTML/PNG 文件。
repos.summary_en: HTML Anything is a local-first, agentic HTML editor that integrates 8 coding agent CLIs (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) with zero API key required. It offers 75 composable skill templates across 9 deliverable formats—from magazines to data reports—and enables one-click export to WeChat, X, Zhihu, HTML, or PNG.

repos.description: 丰富多样的 Web 弹出层组件，可轻松实现 Alert/Confirm/Prompt/ 普通提示/页面区块/iframe/tips等等几乎所有的弹出交互。目前已成为最多人使用的弹层解决方案
repos.summary_zh: layer 是一款功能全面的 Web 弹出层组件，支持 Alert、Confirm、Prompt、提示框、页面区块、iframe 等多种交互模式，兼容 IE6+ 及主流浏览器。现已集成至 Layui 框架，提供高性能、易定制的弹层解决方案，广泛应用于企业级 Web 项目，是开发者首选的轻量级交互组件。
repos.summary_en: Layer is a comprehensive web modal component supporting Alert, Confirm, Prompt, tips, iframe, and more. It offers high performance, cross-browser compatibility (including IE6), and extensive customization. Now fully integrated into Layui, it serves as a lightweight, developer-friendly solution for rich user interactions across millions of web platforms.

repos.description: 🪧 Claude Code / Codex skill — generate Xiaohongshu carousels & WeChat 21:9+1:1 cover pairs. Editorial × Swiss visual systems, 28 layouts, 10 themes, single-file HTML → PNG. 小红书图文 + 公众号封面对
repos.summary_zh: Guizang Social Card Skill 是一款面向 Claude Code / Codex 等 AI Agent 的图文卡片生成技能，专为小红书图文与公众号封面设计。内置 Editorial 与 Swiss 两套视觉系统，提供 28 种版式与 10 套主题，支持单文件 HTML 转 PNG，无需前端构建，自动适配多尺寸输出，集成图片搜索、地图组件与校验脚本，提升内容创作效率。
repos.summary_en: Guizang Social Card Skill is an AI agent skill for Claude Code/Codex that generates Xiaohongshu carousels and WeChat cover pairs. It features Editorial and Swiss visual systems with 28 layouts and 10 themes, converting single-file HTML to PNG without build tools. Includes image sourcing, map components, and validation scripts for streamlined social content creation.

repos.description: 🥷 Engineering habits you already know, turned into skills Claude can run.
repos.summary_zh: Waza 是一套专为 Claude AI 设计的工程技能工具集，将工程师的核心工作习惯（如需求思考、系统设计、代码审查、调试排查等）封装为可执行的 /slash 命令。每个技能包含完整文档、辅助脚本和实战案例，帮助 AI 更专业、严谨地完成开发任务，提升输出质量与可靠性。
repos.summary_en: Waza is a collection of engineering skills for Claude AI, transforming proven developer habits—like requirement analysis, UI design, debugging, and code review—into executable slash commands. Each skill includes documentation, scripts, and real-world failure examples to guide Claude in producing higher-quality, more reliable outputs.

repos.description: 🐬DeepChat - A smart assistant that connects powerful AI to your personal world
repos.summary_zh: DeepChat 是一个功能丰富的开源 AI 智能体平台，统一整合模型、工具和智能体，支持多 LLM 对话、MCP 工具调用和 ACP 智能体集成，提供强大的桌面端 AI 助手体验。
repos.summary_en: DeepChat is a powerful open-source AI agent platform that unifies models, tools, and agents, offering multi-LLM chat, MCP tool calling, and ACP agent integration for seamless desktop AI assistance.

repos.description: 达尔文.skill —— 一个让你的Skill无限进化的系统：评估→改进→测试→保留或回滚 | Autoresearch-inspired autonomous skill optimization for Claude Code. Evaluate, improve, test, keep or revert.
repos.summary_zh: 达尔文.skill 是一个受 autoresearch 启发的自主 Skill 优化系统，通过评估→改进→测试→保留/回滚的闭环循环，持续提升 Claude Code 等 Agent 工具的 Skill 性能。采用双重评估机制（结构质量+实际效果）和棘轮机制，确保每次修改只保留可测量的改进，支持 8 维度加权评分体系与人在回路验证。
repos.summary_en: Darwin.skill is an autonomous skill optimization system inspired by autoresearch, featuring a closed-loop cycle of evaluate-improve-test-keep/revert to continuously enhance agent skills in tools like Claude Code. It employs dual evaluation (structural quality + actual performance) and a ratchet mechanism to ensure only measurable improvements are retained, using an 8-dimensional weighted scoring system with human-in-the-loop validation.

repos.description: Zero-Config Code Flow for Claude code & Codex
repos.summary_zh: ZCF 是一款零配置 Claude Code & Codex 代码流工具，提供一键安装、双语界面、智能代理系统和个性化 AI 助手。支持多种 API 提供商（如 302.AI、GLM、PackyCode 等），内置工作流、MCP 集成，并持续更新维护，适合开发者快速部署 AI 编程环境。
repos.summary_en: ZCF (Zero-Config Code Flow) is a zero-configuration tool for Claude Code & Codex, enabling one-click setup with bilingual support, intelligent agent system, and personalized AI assistants. It supports multiple API providers (e.g., 302.AI, GLM, PackyCode), includes workflows and MCP integration, and is actively maintained for seamless AI coding experience.

repos.description: 多模型协作工作流引擎 — /ccg:go 一个命令，AI 自动分析意图、选择策略、编排 Codex + Gemini + Claude 协作执行
repos.summary_zh: CCG 是一个多模型协作开发系统，通过 Claude 编排 Codex（后端）与 Gemini（前端），提供 28 个命令覆盖完整开发流程。支持零配置路由、安全补丁审查及 OPSX 规范驱动开发，实现 AI 智能体协同编程。
repos.summary_en: CCG is a multi-model collaboration system where Claude orchestrates Codex (backend) and Gemini (frontend), offering 28 slash commands for full-stack development. Features zero-config routing, secure patch review, and OPSX-driven spec development for AI agent teamwork.

repos.description: A lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more.
repos.summary_zh: Skills Manager 是一款轻量级桌面应用，用于统一管理、同步和组织 AI 智能体技能，支持 15+ 主流开发工具（如 Cursor、Claude Code、GitHub Copilot 等）。通过中央仓库集中管理技能，支持从 Git 仓库、本地文件或市场导入，一键同步至目标工具，并提供场景分组、更新追踪和技能文档预览功能。
repos.summary_en: Skills Manager is a lightweight desktop app that centralizes the management, sync, and organization of AI agent skills across 15+ coding tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot. It supports importing skills from Git repos, local folders, or the marketplace into a unified repository, enables one-click sync via symlinks/copies, and offers scenario grouping, update tracking, and in-app skill documentation preview.

repos.description: 【🔞🔞🔞 内含不适合未成年人阅读的图片】基于我擅长的编程、绘画、写作展开的 AI 探索和总结：StableDiffusion 是一种强大的图像生成模型，能够通过对一张图片进行演化来生成新的图片。ChatGPT 是一个基于 Transformer 的语言生成模型，它能够自动为输入的主题生成合适的文章。而 Github Copilot 是一个智能编程助手，能够加速日常编程活动。
repos.summary_zh: 该项目深入探索了基于编程、绘画与写作的AI应用，涵盖StableDiffusion图像生成、ChatGPT文本创作及GitHub Copilot代码辅助。通过Prompt工程实践，系统解析了AI模型在图像描述、文章构思与代码生成中的交互逻辑，并提出了'Prompt编程'概念，探讨自然语言驱动软件开发的可能性。
repos.summary_en: This project explores AI applications in programming, painting, and writing through StableDiffusion image generation, ChatGPT text creation, and GitHub Copilot code assistance. It systematically analyzes how AI models interact with human input via prompt engineering for image description, article structuring, and code generation, proposing the concept of 'prompt programming' as a bridge between natural language and software development.

repos.description: 手绘风格编号画廊与双语提示词 Skill
repos.summary_zh: 整合324种手绘风格、161种排版图型与36种主题色的AI生图提示词库。通过编号精准控制画风与构图，支持智能推荐与精准指定双模式，一键生成中英双语提示词，适配小红书、公众号、条漫等多场景创作。
repos.summary_en: A curated AI image generation prompt library featuring 324 hand-drawn styles, 161 layout templates, and 36 classic color themes. Generate precise bilingual prompts through numbered style codes with smart recommendation and precise selection modes, ideal for social media content, comics, and visual design.

repos.description: Run Claude Design locally as an Agent Skill — Cursor, Claude Code & more. Produce polished UI mockups, prototypes, decks & wireframes as self-contained HTML, without claude.ai/design. Best with Opus or Claude.
repos.summary_zh: baoyu-design 将 Claude Design 设计引擎封装为本地 Agent Skill，可在 Cursor、Claude Code 等编码 Agent 中直接生成高质量 UI 原型、线框图、落地页、仪表盘和演示文稿，输出为自包含 HTML。无需访问 claude.ai/design 网站，支持 Opus 4.8 获得最佳效果，通过 localhost 预览实现可视化迭代编辑。
repos.summary_en: baoyu-design packages the Claude Design engine as a portable Agent Skill, enabling local coding agents like Cursor and Claude Code to generate polished UI mockups, prototypes, wireframes, landing pages, dashboards, and slide decks as self-contained HTML. No website or subscription needed—everything runs locally with tight visual iteration via localhost preview, best paired with Opus 4.8.

repos.description: 让 AI 写的中文读起来像一个具体的人在说话。通用创作与改稿 Skill，开箱即用。
repos.summary_zh: 让 AI 写的中文摆脱模型腔，读起来像具体的人在说话。提供开箱即用的写作 Skill，覆盖知乎、公众号、博客、小说等多种场景，内置事实核查、逻辑推进与中文韵律三重把关，附检测脚本与蒸馏版提示词。
repos.summary_en: Eliminates AI-generated Chinese stiffness, making outputs read like a real person speaking. Provides a ready-to-use writing Skill for Zhihu, WeChat articles, blogs, fiction and more, with built-in fact-checking, logical progression and Chinese rhythm controls, plus a detection script and distilled prompt version.

repos.description: 把 Markdown 一键排成可直接粘进公众号编辑器的精致 HTML —— 6 套精选主题 + 主题生成器 + 双关卡校验。An AI-agent skill that turns Markdown into paste-ready WeChat article HTML.
repos.summary_zh: gzh-design-skill 是一款专为 AI Agent 设计的公众号排版工具，能将 Markdown 一键转换为可直接粘贴进微信公众号编辑器的精致 HTML。它提供 6 套精选主题及自定义主题生成器，通过全内联样式与特定标签规避平台过滤，并具备章节编号、关键词标记及双关卡质量校验功能，确保排版的高保真与一致性。
repos.summary_en: gzh-design-skill is an AI-agent skill that converts Markdown into paste-ready WeChat Official Account HTML. It features 6 preset themes and a custom theme generator, utilizing inline styles and specific tags to bypass platform filters. With auto-numbering, keyword marking, and dual-stage quality validation, it ensures high-fidelity, consistent formatting for content creators.

repos.description: Hold a key, speak, release — AI-polished text appears at your cursor in any app. Open-source voice input for macOS & Windows. (按住快捷键说话，松开即得润色后的文字)
repos.summary_zh: OpenLess 是一款开源的跨平台语音输入工具，支持 macOS 和 Windows。用户按住快捷键说话，松开后即可获得 AI 润色后的文本，并自动插入光标位置或复制到剪贴板。其核心亮点是 AI 提示模式，能将口语化表达转化为结构清晰、上下文丰富的提示词，适用于 ChatGPT、Claude 等 AI 工具，提升输入效率。
repos.summary_en: OpenLess is an open-source, cross-platform voice input app for macOS and Windows. Press a hotkey, speak naturally, and get AI-polished text inserted at your cursor or copied to clipboard. Its standout feature is AI-prompt mode, which transforms rambling speech into structured, context-rich prompts ready for use in ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools.

repos.description: YAO = Yielding AI Outcomes. A rigorous engineering, evaluation, governance, and portability system for reusable agent skills.
repos.summary_zh: YAO是AI智能体技能的可复用工程与治理系统，将重复工作流打包为跨平台技能包。2.0升级为Skill OS，提供技能IR中间表示、目标编译器、评估证据库、发布门禁和技能生命周期治理，实现从创建到迭代的完整闭环。
repos.summary_en: YAO is a rigorous engineering and governance system for reusable AI agent skills. Version 2.0 upgrades to a Skill OS with platform-neutral IR, target compilers, evaluation evidence lab, release gates, and full lifecycle governance — turning repeated workflows into installable, cross-platform skill packages.

repos.description: 《面向开发者的 ChatGPT 提示词工程》非官方版中英双语字幕 Unofficial subtitles of "ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers"
repos.summary_zh: 该项目为非官方中英双语字幕，涵盖吴恩达与 OpenAI 开发者合著的《ChatGPT 提示工程》课程，重点讲解面向开发者的 Prompt 编写技巧，包括文本分类、摘要、翻译、聊天机器人构建等 9 个实战章节，配套交互式 Notebook 与 B 站视频，助力开发者掌握高杠杆 AI 技能。
repos.summary_en: This project provides unofficial bilingual Chinese-English subtitles for Andrew Ng and OpenAI's 'ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers' course, covering 9 practical chapters on prompt writing, including text classification, summarization, translation, and chatbot development, with interactive notebooks and Bilibili videos to help developers master this high-leverage AI skill.

repos.description: Your AI agent skills, finally organized. A macOS app to browse, edit, and manage skills across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, and Amp.
repos.summary_zh: Chops 是一款 macOS 原生应用，专为统一管理和编辑 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Windsurf、Amp 等 AI 编程工具的代码技能而设计。支持实时文件监控、全文搜索、集合分类和远程技能库连接，提供 SwiftUI + SwiftData 架构下的流畅编辑体验。
repos.summary_en: Chops is a native macOS app that centralizes management of AI coding agent skills across tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. It features real-time file watching, full-text search, collections, and remote skill server integration, built with SwiftUI and SwiftData for seamless editing.

repos.description: Boss直聘爬虫 / BOSS直聘职位数据抓取工具，基于 Chrome CDP 协议复用真实登录态，绕过字体反爬，输出明文薪资 JSON/CSV + 薪资技能分析。A Chrome-CDP-based BOSS Zhipin job scraper/crawler.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Chrome CDP 协议的 BOSS直聘职位抓取工具，通过复用本地真实登录态调用官方搜索 API，有效绕过前端字体反爬机制，直接获取明文薪资数据。支持 JSON/CSV 双格式输出，并提供薪资分布、技能词频分析及求职材料优化提示词生成，可作为 CLI 工具或 Hermes Agent Skill 使用。
repos.summary_en: A Chrome CDP-based BOSS Zhipin job scraper that leverages local authenticated sessions to invoke official search APIs, effectively bypassing font anti-scraping to extract plain-text salary data. It supports JSON/CSV output and provides salary distribution analysis, skill frequency statistics, and job application prompt generation, usable as both a CLI tool and a Hermes Agent Skill.

repos.description: BrowserWing turns your browser actions into MCP commands Or Claude Skill, allowing AI agents to control browsers efficiently and reliably. Say goodbye to slow, token-heavy LLM interactions — let agents call commands directly for faster automation. Perfect for AI-driven tasks, browser automation, and boosting productivity.
repos.summary_zh: BrowserWing 是一款原生浏览器自动化平台，支持通过 MCP 协议和 Claude Skill 让 AI 智能体直接控制浏览器。提供 26+ HTTP API 接口、可视化脚本录制、LLM 驱动的数据提取及会话管理，实现高效可靠的浏览器自动化，显著减少 LLM 交互延迟。
repos.summary_en: BrowserWing is a native browser automation platform that enables AI agents to control browsers via MCP commands or Claude Skills. It offers 26+ HTTP APIs, visual script recording, LLM-powered data extraction, and session management for fast, reliable automation with minimal token overhead.

repos.description: 一句话生成大师级海报、书籍封面、专辑封面和各类设计作品。无需懂PS、配色或艺术史，AI自动选择最佳风格（基于20位传奇海报设计师）。支持电影海报、读书笔记、公众号封面、小红书配图等。默认9:16竖版，完美适配社交媒体。包含AI提示词优化、风格对比、图生图转换功能。触发词："Mondo风格"、"书籍封
repos.summary_zh: 乔木Mondo海报设计是一款AI驱动的设计工具，用户只需一句话描述需求，即可自动生成专业级海报、书籍封面、专辑封面等设计作品。基于20位传奇设计师风格库，支持多场景适配（公众号、小红书、电影海报等），内置AI提示词优化与风格对比功能，无需设计基础即可产出大师级作品。
repos.summary_en: Qiaomu Mondo Poster Design is an AI-powered tool that generates professional posters, book covers, and album art from a single sentence. It leverages styles from 20 legendary designers, supports multiple social media formats (WeChat, Xiaohongshu), and includes AI prompt optimization and style comparison features, enabling anyone to create master-level designs without design skills.

repos.description: Awesome AI GPTs, OpenAI GPTs, GPT-4, ChatGPT, GPTs, Prompts, plugins, Prompts leaking
repos.summary_zh: Awesome AI GPTs 是一个精选的 OpenAI GPTs 资源库，涵盖提示词工程、内容创作、编程辅助、数据分析等场景。项目提供热门 GPTs 推荐、插件安装指南、知识库构建工具及安全防护方案，助力用户高效利用 AI 能力。
repos.summary_en: Awesome AI GPTs is a curated collection of OpenAI GPTs resources, covering prompt engineering, content creation, coding assistance, and data analysis. It offers hot GPTs recommendations, plugin installation guides, knowledge base tools, and security solutions to enhance AI utilization.

repos.description: Spec-driven development workflow for AI coding agents: architecture-first planning, task decomposition, GitHub Issue/PR tracking, Deep Discuss, and adaptive control for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other Markdown-capable agents.
repos.summary_zh: Spec-Driven Develop 是一个平台无关的 AI 代理技能，通过单个 `SKILL.md` 文件为大规模复杂任务提供全流程预开发自动化。它不依赖框架或运行时，而是以纯 Markdown 结构化指令驱动代理完成项目分析、任务拆解、进度跟踪和迭代开发，实现轻量级但高度可控的开发方法论。
repos.summary_en: Spec-Driven Develop is a platform-agnostic AI agent skill that automates pre-development workflows via a single SKILL.md file. It enables any coding agent to execute structured methodologies—including project analysis, task decomposition, and progress tracking—without frameworks or runtime dependencies, offering lightweight yet powerful automation for complex tasks.

repos.description: ✨ AI Gist 是一款隐私优先的 AI 提示词管理工具，致力于让个人收藏的 AI 提示词能够发挥最大价值。支持变量替换、Jinja 模板、AI 生成与调优、历史版本记录、云端备份等核心功能。
repos.summary_zh: AI Gist 是一款隐私优先的 AI 提示词管理工具，支持 Jinja 模板与变量动态替换，集成多种 AI 模型实现自动生成与调优提示词。所有数据本地存储，支持 WebDAV/iCloud 云端备份，跨 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 多平台运行，帮助用户高效收藏与管理个人提示词资产。
repos.summary_en: AI Gist is a privacy-first AI prompt management tool featuring Jinja template support and dynamic variable substitution. It integrates multiple AI models for auto-generating and optimizing prompts, with all data stored locally. Cloud backup via WebDAV/iCloud is supported. Cross-platform for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS, it helps users efficiently collect and manage personal prompt assets.

repos.summary_zh: VSC社区维护的Codex Skills集合，聚焦AIGC创作与视觉工作流。提供提示词工程、稀有风格探索、东方神话插画、抓拍人像摄影及虚拟Vlog生成等技能封装，支持一键安装至Codex并通过$skill-name调用，辅助创作者高效复用创意方法与管理生成资产。
repos.summary_en: A community-maintained collection of Codex Skills focused on AIGC creation and visual workflows. Covers prompt engineering, rare style exploration, Eastern mythology illustration, candid photography prompts, and virtual vlog generation. Skills are installed into Codex and invoked via $skill-name for efficient creative reuse and asset management.

repos.description: Useful GPT Prompts
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库收集并整理了实用的 GPT 提示词，涵盖 Midjourney 等 AI 工具的生成模板，旨在提升用户与 AI 交互的效率和创意表达，适用于内容创作、设计辅助等场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates useful GPT prompts, starting with a Midjourney Prompt Generator, designed to enhance AI interaction efficiency and creative output for content creation and design assistance.

repos.description: Canonical source and governance toolkit for Zhijian AI public Agent Skills
repos.summary_zh: Zhijian Skills 是 OpenAI Codex Agent 的官方技能分发仓库，提供19个专注于 Codex 操作、工作流编排、模型推理与知识系统的即插即用技能包。支持通过 npx 一行命令快速安装，涵盖模型路由、上下文诊断、跨 Agent 交接、企业数字孪生、长文写作等场景。
repos.summary_en: Zhijian Skills is the canonical distribution repository for OpenAI Codex Agent Skills, offering 19 plug-and-play modules covering workflow orchestration, model routing, context diagnosis, cross-agent handoff, enterprise digital twins, and long-form writing. Install via a single npx command, with independently verified releases and complete payloads.

repos.description: Agent skill that draws architecture, flowchart, sequence, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams as hand-placed SVG, to one linted house style.
repos.summary_zh: SVG 手绘风格架构图绘制技能，为 AI 编码代理提供统一的布局算术、颜色系统与零依赖校验器，支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等 40+ 代理，确保生成的序列图、数据流图、生命周期图经 svg-lint 12 项检查后保持 house 样式一致。
repos.summary_en: An agent skill that draws hand-crafted SVG diagrams — architecture, flowchart, sequence, data-flow, lifecycle — following a unified house style with layout arithmetic, a color system, and a zero-dependency linter (svg-lint) with 12 checks. Works with 40+ AI coding agents including Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot.

repos.description: A fast, native RSS reader — plus an agent-facing CLI so your AI agent can read, search and triage your feeds from the shell.
repos.summary_zh: Papr 是一款专为桌面端设计的快速原生 RSS 阅读器，支持订阅管理、智能分类、全文抓取、AI 摘要与问答、音频播放及 FreshRSS 同步，数据本地存储于 SQLite，无云端依赖，提供多语言界面。
repos.summary_en: Papr is a fast, native desktop RSS reader featuring feed organization, smart views, full-text fetching, AI-powered summaries and Q&A, audio playback, FreshRSS sync, and local-first data storage via SQLite—no cloud or account required.

repos.description: 🏯 Claude Code / Codex skill — transform Chinese architecture, cultural places & travel photos into art-directed editorial posters with GPT Image. 中国古建筑与在地文化照片 → 艺术指导海报
repos.summary_zh: Yingzao 是将中国古建筑、文化场所与旅行照片转为艺术指导编辑海报的 Agent Skill。它通过构图识别、中式排版设计与图像重绘，保护建筑身份锚点，实现文字与主体的深度互动，支持多图融合与视频分镜扩展。
repos.summary_en: Yingzao is an agent skill that transforms Chinese architectural and cultural photos into art-directed editorial posters. It combines composition analysis, Chinese typography design, and image model generation to preserve architectural identity while creating meaningful text-image interactions, with support for multi-image fusion and video storyboard extension.

repos.description: Agent Skill for Chinese-first HyperFrames motion-video production from articles, products, websites, and README files.
repos.summary_zh: HyperFrames Motion Director 是一款专为中文场景优化的 AI Agent 技能，旨在将文章、产品文档或 README 快速转化为 9:16 竖版动态视频。它采用两阶段工作流（先确认创意提案，再生成素材与合成），通过严格的布局契约与动效引导，确保输出符合专业标准的宣传片与文字动画。
repos.summary_en: HyperFrames Motion Director is an AI Agent skill optimized for Chinese-first workflows, transforming articles, product docs, or READMEs into 9:16 vertical motion videos. Utilizing a two-phase pipeline (brief confirmation followed by asset generation and composition), it enforces strict layout contracts and attention-guiding animations to produce professional kinetic typography and promotional content.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 Claude Sonnet 4.5 的多平台AI写作助手，提供从选题、创作到审校的全流程自动化工作流。通过个人素材库学习作者风格，采用三遍审校机制降低AI味至15-20%，集成标题优化、配图Prompt生成等功能，支持微信公众号、Twitter、小红书等多平台内容适配。
repos.summary_en: A multi-platform AI writing agent built on Claude Sonnet 4.5, offering end-to-end automation from ideation to publication. Features style learning via personal material library, three-round editing to reduce AI flavor to 15-20%, and integrated title optimization with image prompt generation, supporting content adaptation across WeChat, Twitter, Xiaohongshu and other platforms.

repos.description: 让 Codex、Claude Code 等 AI Agent 成为你的跨平台电脑维修助手：64 个按需加载的 Playbook，覆盖诊断、清理、性能、网络与安全维护——C 盘爆满、电脑卡顿、流氓软件、应用迁移、数据恢复都能直接问；先取证、再计划，确认后修改。
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个面向AI Agent的跨平台电脑维修Skill，提供64个按需加载的Playbook，覆盖Windows/macOS/Linux的诊断、清理、性能优化、网络与安全维护。采用
repos.summary_en: A cross-platform computer repair Skill for AI Agents, featuring 64 on-demand Playbooks covering Windows, macOS, and Linux diagnostics, cleanup, performance optimization, and security maintenance. Follows an evidence-first, plan-confirm-modify workflow for natural language-based PC troubleshooting.

repos.description: 为访谈视频添加综艺风格视觉特效的 Claude Skill。AI 分析字幕内容生成建议，用户审批后自动渲染。A Claude Skill for adding variety-show-style visual effects to interview videos. The AI analyzes subtitle content to generate suggestions
repos.summary_zh: Video-Wrapper-Skills 是一个 Claude Skill，专为访谈/播客视频添加综艺风格视觉特效。通过 AI 分析字幕内容自动生成效果建议（如关键短语、下三分之一栏、术语卡等），支持用户审批后一键渲染输出。提供 4 种主题风格（Notion、赛博朋克、Apple、极光）和双渲染引擎（浏览器/PIL），实现高质量专业级视频包装。
repos.summary_en: Video-Wrapper-Skills is a Claude Skill that adds variety-show-style visual effects to interview/podcast videos. It uses AI to analyze subtitles, auto-generate effect suggestions (e.g., key phrases, lower thirds, term cards), and enables one-click professional rendering after user approval. Features 4 themes (Notion, Cyberpunk, Apple, Aurora) and dual rendering engines (browser/PIL) for high-quality output.

repos.description: 影子作家 · 为角色建立可复用的写作与语言特征模型，让 AI 稳定地「像某个人」说话。Python / Agent Skill 双形态。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目'ghostwriter'（影子作家）提供多来源语言特征JSON数据集，涵盖微博、文学影视角色及历史人物，支持非商业用途研究。采用CC BY-NC-ND 4.0许可，结合长上下文大模型可显著提升文本生成风格拟合度，适用于AI角色模拟与语言分析。
repos.summary_en: The 'ghostwriter' project provides structured linguistic feature datasets in JSON format, covering sources like Weibo, literary characters, and historical figures. Licensed under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 for non-commercial use, it enhances AI text generation when combined with large language models featuring long context capabilities, ideal for character simulation and stylistic analysis.

repos.description: Agent Skills for theming AI desktop apps: reference image → reversible Codex/WorkBuddy skin → verify, repair, publish. | 给 AI 桌面应用换肤的 Agent Skills：参考图 → 可逆皮肤 → 验证、修复、发布。
repos.summary_zh: CodeDrobe Skills 是一个开源的 AI 桌面应用主题生成与管理系统，专为 OpenAI Codex 和腾讯 WorkBuddy 等基于 Chromium/Electron 的 AI 桌面端提供可逆的主题定制方案。它通过 AI 技能（Skill）驱动，支持 DOM 快照分析、语义化主题生成与跨平台应用，极大简化了 AI 桌面环境的个性化与视觉管理。
repos.summary_en: CodeDrobe Skills is an open-source AI-driven theming engine for Chromium/Electron-based AI desktop apps like OpenAI Codex and Tencent WorkBuddy. It provides a reversible theme customization workflow utilizing DOM snapshot analysis and semantic generation. Managed via installable Agent Skills, it simplifies visual personalization and cross-platform theme deployment for AI desktop environments.

repos.summary_zh: 刘聪 NLP 的 Agent Skill 仓库，提供可复用的提示工程模块。核心包含三渲二动画短片提示词生成（覆盖剧情、角色、Midjourney 故事板与 Seedance 视频提示）与微信公众号标题策略分析（多风格生成、评分及风险检查）。通过软链接安装实现热更新，专为 AI Agent 平台设计，大幅提升内容创作自动化效率。
repos.summary_en: A repository of reusable Agent Skills for NLP tasks by Liucong. It features a 3D-to-2D animation prompt generator (covering storyboards for Midjourney and Seedance) and a WeChat public account title strategist (multi-style generation, scoring, and risk checking). Designed for AI Agent platforms with hot-reload support via symlinks, it significantly boosts content creation automation.

repos.description: ByeType 是一个 Markdown 驱动的 AI 语音输入工具，用多模态大模型直接处理原始音频。编辑 Markdown 文件即可自定义专有词汇、转录规则和格式化策略，人名、术语、口水词、数字格式一次转录到位，减少二次修改。支持 macOS、Windows 和 iOS。
repos.summary_zh: ByeType 是一款基于 Markdown 驱动的 AI 语音输入工具，利用多模态大模型直接处理原始音频，支持自定义专有词汇、转录规则和格式化策略。通过编辑 Markdown 提示词，实现人名、术语、数字格式等一次性精准转写，减少二次修改，支持 macOS、Windows 和 iOS 平台。
repos.summary_en: ByeType is a Markdown-driven AI voice input tool that uses multimodal large models to directly process raw audio. It supports custom vocabulary, transcription rules, and formatting strategies via editable Markdown prompts. Achieving accurate, one-time transcription of names, terms, and numbers without post-processing, it runs on macOS, Windows, and iOS.

repos.description: One Page Agent.The browser-native workbench that lives in One Page.
repos.summary_zh: OnePagent 是一款单文件部署的浏览器原生 AI 智能体工作台，仅需一个 HTML 文件即可实现多轮对话、工具调用、Python 沙箱、网络搜索及长期记忆等全功能。支持多 LLM 提供商、MCP 服务器集成与子代理协作，无需后端或构建工具，开箱即用。
repos.summary_en: OnePagent is a single-file, browser-native AI agent workbench delivering full functionality—multi-turn chat, tool calls, Python sandbox, web search, and long-term memory—in one HTML file. It supports multi-provider LLMs, MCP server integration, and sub-agent collaboration with zero backend or build dependencies.

repos.description: A skill for coding agents that build, review, and refactor Web UI that should be easier for humans, screen readers, browser automation, Playwright tests, and AI agents to understand and operate.
repos.summary_zh: 为AI编码代理提供的Web UI设计技能，指导构建、审查与重构前端界面，使其对人类、屏幕阅读器、浏览器自动化、Playwright测试及AI代理更友好。核心聚焦语义HTML、清晰状态、稳定定位器与可复现URL模式，附带分级审查报告，助力提升前端可访问性与自动化兼容性。
repos.summary_en: A skill for coding agents to build, review, and refactor Web UI that is easier for humans, screen readers, browser automation, Playwright tests, and AI agents to understand and operate. It focuses on semantic HTML, clear state, stable locators, and reproducible URL patterns, providing severity-graded review reports to enhance accessibility and automation compatibility.

repos.description: 🛡️ Workspace file protection plugin for OpenClaw — guards against prompt injection attacks
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw Guard 插件为 OpenClaw AI 代理提供工作区文件防护，有效防御提示注入攻击。通过拦截外部会话的文件操作，自动屏蔽对身份、记忆等关键文件的读写，并将非关键写入重定向至沙箱目录，确保主会话权限隔离与系统安全。
repos.summary_en: The OpenClaw Guard plugin protects OpenClaw AI agents from prompt injection attacks by intercepting file operations in external sessions. It blocks access to critical files like identity and memory, redirecting non-sensitive writes to a sandboxed directory, ensuring secure agent isolation and integrity.
